title: Each API route the repository writes has one unit test file, route.test.ts
context: Route unit tests were split across route.test.ts, request-schema.test.ts and files named after an action, so the same kind of case lived in different files for different routes. Some route test files never imported their route, and the Better Auth catch-all's handler is generated whole by the library.
decision: Each API route whose handler the repository writes has exactly one unit test file, __tests__/route.test.ts beside its route.ts, holding every unit case for that route, request-schema rejections included. Cases moved out of integration tests, the existing request-schema.test.ts files and action-named files are merged into it; a file that never runs its route is deleted, not merged. A route whose handler a library generates whole, such as the Better Auth catch-all, has no unit test.

alternatives.option: A separate request-schema.test.ts for validation cases
alternatives.reason: Which file a case belongs in would be a judgement the one-file rule removes.

alternatives.option: Merge a file that never runs its route into route.test.ts
alternatives.reason: Its cases assert only values the test built, so merging them proves nothing more.

alternatives.option: Unit-test a library-generated route with the library replaced
alternatives.reason: Nothing of the route is left to run; the test would prove only that the app's instance is passed along.

consequences: Some route test files grow to a few hundred lines.
The Better Auth catch-all has no automated test until end-to-end or API smoke tests exist.
